main.formula: 0016 §1's formula, derived (gate fix round 1 item 2, replacing the fitted 120: `ceil(measured) + 8 B` with no attribution). Measured (`playwright test --project gc --grep "terrain clean" --repeat-each 8 --workers 1`, this machine, after fix round 1 items 1/3/4/5/6/7): `bytesPerFrame.main` a tight 107.4867-107.8933 B/frame across all 8 clean runs -- down from the prior round's 111.35-111.39 (item 1's preallocated/batched descriptors removed the ~3.6-3.9 B/frame difference; the orchestrator's own guess of ~10 B/frame was too high, per-call descriptor literals amortised to less than that once INDIR was also batched to one `writeTexture` call per record instead of one per entry). Decomposition (one clean run's own full `byFn`, top-8 cutoff widened to 40 entries locally to capture every site, not committed -- reverted after this measurement): (a) named WebGPU wrapper objects -- `draw()` creates exactly 3 per frame, `createCommandEncoder`/`beginRenderPass`/`encoder.finish()` (`target.createView()` is skipped: this device's real, unforced `viewProbePasses` is `true`) -- 28,800 B / 600 frames = 48.0 B/frame = 3 x 16 B exactly; (b) tasks that touch WebGPU -- `render/upload.ts`'s `drain()` (TurboFan inlines `applyChunk`/`writePageChunkBytes`/`writeChunkTexture`'s one `queue.writeTexture()` call into `drain`'s own frame, so it is the attribution site, not a missing preallocation) -- 12,000 B / 600 / 24 B per task = 20.0 B/frame (500 tasks over the window, identical across all 8 runs: item 3's own 8-chunk cache under a wide view keeps the ring non-empty on roughly 5 of every 6 frames); (c) harness overhead -- every other named site (`harness.stepFrame`'s own ack-spin and `ManualClock.advance`, `page.evaluate`'s CDP JSON round-trip of `run()`'s return value, `parkWorkers`/`resumeWorkers`/`pollUntil`/`errors` one-time setup amortised over 600 frames) -- 23,816 B / 600 = 39.69 B/frame, the only bucket that varies run to run (V8 sampling-profiler timing noise, not a per-frame allocation: `draw`/`drain` were the identical 28,800/12,000 B in every one of the 8 runs). (a) + (b) + (c) = 107.73 B/frame, matching that run's own reported `bytesPerFrame.main` (107.73333...) to 5 decimal places -- residual 0 B/frame, well under the 2 B/frame ceiling. `ceil(107.8933) = 108`, `+ 8 B margin (0016 §1's own convention) = 116`.
